body:
ACCEPT this refinement. Established(empty) is a positive scientific assertion; it cannot stand in for failure to derive the universe.

The admission rule should therefore be conditional and total: an Established universe requires exactly-once accounting of every member, while an Unestablished universe requires the failed stage, typed reason, and attempt receipt and forbids every denominator-based support or coverage statistic. The report can still be complete as an invocation record while the scientific result is partial or refused.

I also accept separating semantic outcome from per-artifact report outcome. That prevents an HTML/layout failure from erasing a valid scientific result and prevents a provider/planner failure from minting an empty semantic model. No further vocabulary proposal or implementation action from me.
